dedupe_keys.name: synthetic high voltage insulator segmentation and contamination images

description: This dataset supplies synthetic images of ceramic, polymer and glass insulator strings on high-voltage transmission structures. The Brazilian research and utility collaborators create scenes with varied landscapes, lighting and contamination to support automated inspection. Zenodo publishes separate segmentation and classification archives free under CC BY 4.0. The segmentation set is described as 47,286 images. Classification counts conflict: the repository reports 14,432, while the article reports 14,424, and the repository’s per-material arithmetic does not reconcile. Image encoding inside the archives was not inspected. Coverage is rendered scenes without an observation calendar or representative field geography. Synthetic dirt appearance does not establish electrical flashover probability or real deterioration rates. A reviewer-assessed use is testing visual-condition components linked to infrastructure digital twins. model-pandapower provides related electrical-network simulation, but no image-to-equipment-risk mapping is supplied or verified. No image archive was downloaded.
name: Synthetic high-voltage insulator segmentation and contamination images
notes: G2-0171. Metadata only. Proposed simulation uses are reviewer assessments. No dataset, model or article PDF downloaded; no program executed.
